_about: 古八's boards (h09; the per-回 plan 2026-10-15, done 2026-10-21): fewer, better — the 回 reads three scenes (09-dabi, 09-qulao, 09-cliff) and keeps one board and one fight, both in 09-dabi. Since 2026-10-28 (doc/gates-2026-10-27.md 古八 (a + c)) the years have their scenes again — 年六 09-dabi · 09-shenshi, 年七 09-dingfeng · 09-laba (the final, 09-laba/dabi), 年八 09-yanceng — with twenty classic boards below, a stage quest a year. The board is 守炉's 古八 story level (Hanli 10-20: a new level a 回 from 古四 on): 闵丹师 has lit the furnace and cannot leave it, the 看炉 is 小满's, the 后山's 鬿雀 come for the smell. The fight is the 腊八 大比's final on the way on (09-dabi/dabi, `foe-jiuceng`, the 金刃 that gasps between blades). Told, never played: 《金丹》's recitation and the 挑料 (a quiz and a pick — the weak-board rule), 定风's candle and 进退's pine bough (no kit's verb), the 回家 night (09-qulao — the 回's heart) and the 筑基 (09-cliff — the 突破 card and its 大场面 are the beat).
_economy: Pay declared here for the economy model (tools/balance.mjs reads tasks/*.json): 修为 +5 (danfang-kanlu, the board table; its 灵石 the board's rank), and its `gives` — the 十年黄精, whose 方子 in the 饭桶 (fantong.json recipes `jiujie`) gives three 三转聚气丹 (30 修为 each, the task table) the night he feeds it. The final pays the scene table's 灵石 20 (no story 修为). The two stage quests stand as they were (caps.hui.h09.gates since 2026-10-28: 七层 at 09-shenshi/winter, 八层 at 09-dingfeng/laba, 九层 at 09-yanceng/ruqiu); the 后山's 猲狙 and 鬿雀 (places/xu.json yaoyuan-wai, `from: h09`) and 兽潮 are where he grinds them.

title.en: Guard the Furnace · Watching the pill furnace

how.zh: 药气飘上后山，鬿雀直扑炉口。点虚线圈布符——剑阵够得着天上，火符烧山道上的野猪——守到闵丹师开炉。
how.en: The smell of the herbs drifts up the back hill and the qique dive at the furnace. Tap a dashed ring to lay a talisman — swords reach the sky, fire burns the boars on the road — and hold till Min opens the furnace.

done_line.zh: 天亮的时候，闵丹师从炉口直起腰来，看了一眼那点火：「嗯。」
done_line.en: At daybreak Pill-master Min straightens from the furnace mouth and looks at the little flame: "Mm."

how.zh: 灵力往鞋底一垫：点一下跳，空中碰到金环再点，矮顶底下别跳。碰上了，从头。
how.en: A cushion of power under the soles: tap to jump, tap again on a gold ring in the air, stay down under the low roofs. Touch one, start over.

done_line.zh: 「脚尖先着地，灵力从脚跟上撤，跟收剑一个道理。」
done_line.en: "Toes touch first, spiritual power comes off at the heels, same as sheathing a sword."

title.zh: 捉虫 · 阿禾那一小条地

how.zh: 哪棵稻上爬了虫，就往哪儿捉；没虫的地方，白翻。
how.en: Wherever a bug is on a stalk, pick it off there; where there isn't one, the search is wasted.

done_line.zh: 阿禾那一小条地年年种，年年多半是瘪穗。
done_line.en: Ahe planted her little strip of earth every year, and every year the ears came up mostly empty.

replay.zh: 药园东角那一小条地……再去捉一回虫？
replay.en: The little strip in the herb garden's east corner... pick off the bugs again?

done_line.en: Master Chu held his wrist twice as long as anyone else's before he gave out the two words.
